attributes.name: reason
attributes.description: One sentence, max 25 words, explaining the rating in neutral language. Do not diagnose or speculate about health.

attributes.name: theme
attributes.description: The single dominant theme: workload, management, team, career, tools, recognition, wellbeing, none.

parameters.content:
## 1. Friday dispatch
Every Friday 09:00, mails the pulse form link to every row in the employees data table where is_active and receives_pulse are both true.

Form is published at https://vibe-coded-8s97.vercel.app/

The link carries employee_id AND email, so the form pre-fills and the submission matches even if someone types a different address.

## 2. Submission handler
Intake is the hosted two-page form (pulse-form.html), which POSTs JSON to the webhook below:
https://YOUR-N8N-HOST/webhook/pulse-submit

Payload: mood, mood_label, mood_score, drivers[], details, wants_outreach, work_email, employee_id.

Then: look up the row in the employees data table by email OR employee_id -> AI severity rating -> log the case to pulse_cases -> email the business partner with the "Mark as attended" button.

Routing is by bp_email on the employee row, not a hard-coded IF. The lookup is an OR match, so the is_active check lives in "Employee Record Found?". Critical severity also pings the HR lead. Unmatched or inactive submissions go to the alert mail instead of being lost.

## 3. Attended callback
The button in the BP email hits this webhook with case_id + token. If the case exists and is still open it is marked attended and the BP sees a confirmation page. Already-closed or invalid links get a harmless "nothing to do" page. This section must be active for the button to work.

## 4. Reminder sweep
Every day at 09:00, any case still pending more than 2 days that has not already been reminded gets one nudge to the business partner, then reminder_sent is flagged so it never repeats. Change the 2 in "Pending Over 2 Days?" to retune the SLA.
